heading: Earth, Geology and Mountains
description: Fifty illustrated topics exploring solid ground, deep mountain roots, rock colours, earthquakes, water in stone, and iron.

grading_guide.A: Clear, direct match between what the verse describes and what science well understands—still read thoughtfully rather than as a lab textbook.
grading_guide.B: Good, helpful connection with observable nature, health, mind, or community life—where context and careful reading matter.
grading_guide.C: Open to thoughtful discussion—clear science paired with a broad theme or a verse understood in more than one careful way.
grading_guide.D: Faith and spiritual guidance—teaches beliefs, morals, or the afterlife, which belong to faith rather than science experiments.

quranic_evidence.verification_status: Reference retained from the supplied dataset; Arabic text and translation not transcribed or independently verified in this draft.
quranic_evidence.context_note: Read the complete passage and surrounding verses before making a scientific claim.

classical_tafsir_review.note: Al-Tabari records early scholarly reports about multiple earths; these reports are not equivalent to modern geological layers. The verse must not be claimed as proof of Earth's internal crust-mantle-core structure.

scientific_evidence.summary: Earth has several scientifically identified internal regions, including the crust, mantle, outer core and inner core.
scientific_evidence.source_scope_note: These sources support the general scientific background. They do not, by themselves, establish that the verse anticipated the finding.

connection_analysis.assessment: The verse refers to seven earths, which has prompted various theological and modern interpretations.
connection_analysis.interpretive_limit: Modern geology does not establish that the verse's seven earths correspond to seven physical geological layers. The interpretation requires careful examination of classical tafsir and Arabic usage.
connection_analysis.publication_caution: Avoid the phrase 'scientific miracle' unless the wording, historical interpretation. Scientific claim are independently established and the correspondence is specific rather than broad.

science_sources: Peer-reviewed geology and Earth science journals

recommended_scientific_references.title: What is an earthquake and what causes them to happen?

research_rules: Verify every Quranic reference and Arabic wording before publication.
Check the complete verse and surrounding context.
Distinguish classical tafsir from modern interpretations.
Do not invent hadith references or authenticity grades.
Do not claim that mountains prevent earthquakes.
Do not claim that seven earths have been scientifically proven to be seven geological layers.
Do not equate the word sent down in the iron verse with a proven meteorite-origin claim.
Use peer-reviewed scientific sources for specific geological claims.
Add exact scientific paper titles, authors, publication years and DOI links only after verification.
Do not classify eschatological descriptions as experimentally proven geological predictions.
Preserve limitations and alternative interpretations in every entry.

research_scope.purpose: A source-linked research draft for evaluating the 50 original topic candidates. It is not a list of 50 established scientific miracles.
research_scope.method: Original topic wording, references, findings, connections, limitations, and grades are retained. External scientific sources are linked as background evidence. Where a source only supports the general scientific topic, it is not presented as proof of the Qur'anic interpretation.
research_scope.grading_note: Original grades are preserved, not independently re-scored in this pass. Treat them as provisional pending verse-by-verse Arabic/translation review, classical tafsir review, and topic-specific scientific literature review.
research_scope.interpretive_rule: Separate the Qur'anic wording and context, classical tafsir, modern scientific knowledge, and any proposed correspondence. Similarity alone does not establish prediction or miracle.

quality_control_summary.evidence_grades: Original grades retained as provisional; not upgraded.
critical_cautions: Mountains do not stop tectonic plate motion or prevent earthquakes; mountain building is commonly a result of tectonic processes.
Mountain roots and isostasy vary; not every mountain range has a simple deep crustal root, and a peg analogy is not a technical geological description.
Eschatological passages about mountains moving or being crushed are not direct descriptions of ordinary erosion, plate tectonics, or current geophysical processes.
Qur'an 65:12 must not be mapped onto the Earth's crust, mantle, and core as if this were an established scientific interpretation.
A passage about the earth's creation in days is theological language; geological age estimates do not independently verify or falsify that language without a clearly defined interpretive framework.
General scientific facts about landforms, minerals, water, and soil are not by themselves evidence of a miraculous prediction.
